non_blocking_findings.finding: Context Hub now exposes required surfaces, but it intentionally does not read or edit anchors, notes, errors, graph nodes, or per-session settings.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep LEG-020 through LEG-024 open until P5 data/repository and graph renderer tasks add real persistence, linking, and interaction evidence.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Graph is represented by a deferred state, not a native Canvas renderer.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Implement graph state/layout/gesture work in NATIVE-P5-003 and NATIVE-P5-004 before claiming graph parity.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Bottom navigation remains horizontally scrollable and still exposes too many top-level items for small phones.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Move About and Import/export under Settings or a More pattern in the shell navigation UX follow-up.

non_blocking_findings.finding: P5-001 has HMA-AL00 screenshots/XML and an instrumentation smoke test, but not full dark mode, dynamic type, TalkBack, IME, and small-screen matrix coverage.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep complete UI quality validation in the later UX QA task.
